title: 第23章 便宜那二皇女了第24章 京城四大美女
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
李逵丝毫不知道自己无形中得罪了人。
就在李逵一点自信的时候，里面走出一个女子。
“小莲姑娘！”
原本都准备撤退的众人，瞬间眼神一亮，虽然没有机会让清雅姑娘留宿，但是要是能跟小莲姑娘今晚……那也是绝好的呀！
李逵也眼神一亮，他目光痴痴的看着小莲，光是这个小莲，模样便不输于寻常青楼的头牌花魁了。
要是今天能够让这个小莲侍寝，那今晚也算是没白来。
李逵心中这样想着，便看到小莲姑娘朝着众人打了个招呼，便径直的朝着自己这个方向而来。
李逵心中扑通扑通的跳着，他……被选中了？
难道，这个小莲姑娘看自己气质出众，不知从哪里知道自己父亲是户部员外，便准备将自己留下，替主上阵，让自己今晚快活一哉？
李逵在心中脑补着，然后眼角余光便看到小莲姑娘从自己身旁掠过，来到自己刚刚想结交的那个杨喜身前。
“公子，我家小姐有请！”
小莲脆生生的喊道，对着夏辰施了一礼，顿时，那件洁白的衣服紧紧贴着身躯，将身材衬托的婀娜起伏，圆润的臀展露无遗。
看的在场众人皆呼吸一屏，目光火热，呼吸粗重。
但同时他们也有些发呆，什么，今晚清雅姑娘留人了，留的还是这人？
大家对夏辰还有点印象，之前清雅姑娘在这个人身上多停留了一个呼吸间。
但后来游戏时，清雅姑娘的目光从未停在他身上，而夏辰自身表现的也平平无奇，众人便也不再关注了。
几位先前表现良好的才子顿时站了起来，面色不服。
凭什么后来者居上？是因为他们不争不抢吗？
开玩笑是关女人的事，还是事关今晚能否与清雅姑娘深度交流，没人想让出这个机会。
“小莲姑娘，这有些不公平吧，这人今晚表现的可谓平平无奇！”

有人当即大声问了出来。
而站在夏辰旁边的李逵早就已经石化了，他刚刚还说清雅姑娘不可能留他们过夜，自己还说要转场找个青楼，请这个杨喜潇洒潇洒，结果转头这个杨喜就被选中了？
凭什么？大家都是戴面具的，分不清帅丑，就凭对方气质比自己略微出众亿点点吗？
看着院内有些群雄激愤，场面略微有些失控的一幕，小莲深吸一口气，然后再次露出笑脸。
“诸位公子，最终能否留在清雅小筑过夜，还是要看我家小姐的心意，今晚我家小姐已经确定了心意，诸位改日再来吧！”
小莲说完然后又转头看一下夏辰。
“这位公子，请吧！”
“你们先回去吧！”
夏辰起身，对着身后的夏千和李喜说道。
夏千刚想要说什么，李喜一脸笑容，拉着夏千抢先说道。
“行嘞，头儿，不过明天早上可要早点起了，明天营里有任务，估计是提灯人那边要我们去帮忙。”
李喜小声的在夏辰耳边说道，然后给了夏辰一个男人都懂的眼神。
夏辰没有多搭理李喜，跟在小莲身后，但在经过还有些发呆的李逵身边时，李逵一把抓住夏辰，他眼神发亮的看着夏辰。
“杨兄，这其中可是有什么秘诀，为何你能够……被清雅姑娘看中！”
李逵微微停顿，最终还是没把走后门几个字说出来。
他也想知道怎么走后门，走清雅姑娘的后门那多爽啊！
content_en:
Li Kui had no idea that he had offended someone inadvertently.
Just when Li Kui was feeling a little more confident, a woman walked out.
"Miss Xiaolian!"
Everyone who was originally preparing to retreat suddenly brightened their eyes. Although there was no chance for Miss Qingya to stay overnight, it would be great if they could stay with Miss Xiaolian tonight...
Li Kui's eyes also lit up, and he looked at Xiao Lian with his eyes. This Xiao Lian alone looked as good as the top oiran in an ordinary brothel.
If I can let this Xiao Lian sleep with me today, then tonight will be considered to be worthwhile.
With Li Kui thinking in his mind, he saw Miss Xiaolian saying hello to everyone, and then came straight in his direction.
Li Kui's heart was pounding. He... was selected?
Could it be that this girl Xiaolian saw that she had outstanding temperament and somehow knew that her father was a member of the Ministry of Household Affairs, so she was ready to leave her behind to fight for the master, so that she could be happy tonight?
Li Kui was thinking in his mind, and then out of the corner of his eye, he saw Miss Xiao Lian passing by him and coming to the Yang happy whom he just wanted to make friends with.
"Sir, my young lady invites you!"
Xiao Lian shouted crisply and saluted Xia Chen. Immediately, the white dress hugged her body tightly, highlighting her graceful figure and revealing her round buttocks.
Everyone present took a breath as they watched, with fiery eyes and heavy breathing.
But at the same time, they were also in a daze. What, Miss Qingya kept someone tonight, and this is the one she kept?
Everyone still has some impression of Xia Chen. Miss Qingya stayed on this person for one more breath before.
But later during the game, Miss Qingya's eyes never stopped on him, and Xia Chen's own performance was mediocre, so everyone stopped paying attention.
Several talents who had performed well before suddenly stood up, looking unconvinced.
Why do latecomers come first? Is it because they don’t fight or grab?
Whether the joke is about the woman or whether she can have a deep communication with the elegant girl tonight, no one wants to give up this opportunity.
"Miss Xiaolian, this is a bit unfair, this person's performance tonight is mediocre!"
Someone immediately asked loudly.
Li Kui, who was standing next to Xia Chen, had already turned to stone. He had just said that it was impossible for Miss Qingya to keep them overnight. He also said that he wanted to find a brothel and invite this Yang Xi to be cool and unrestrained. But then he turned around and this Yang happy was chosen?
Why? Everyone wears a mask, so you can't tell the difference between handsome and ugly, just because the other person's temperament is slightly better than your own?
Seeing the scene where some heroes in the courtyard were furious and the situation was slightly out of control, Xiaolian took a deep breath and then smiled again.
"Gentlemen, whether you can stay in Qingya Xiaozhu for the night depends on my lady's wishes. My lady has made up her mind tonight. Please come back another day!"
After Xiaolian finished speaking, she turned to look at Xia Chen.
"Master, please do it!"
"You guys go back first!"
Xia Chen stood up and said to Xia Qian and Li Xi behind him.
Just when Xia Qian was about to say something, Li Xi pulled Xia Qian to speak first with a smile on his face.
"Okay, boss, but we have to get up early tomorrow morning. There is a mission in the camp tomorrow, and I guess the lantern man wants us to help."
Li Xi whispered in Xia Chen's ear, and then gave Xia Chen a look that any man could understand.
Xia Chen ignored Li Xi and followed Xiaolian, but when he passed by Li Kui, who was still in a daze, Li Kui grabbed Xia Chen and looked at Xia Chen with bright eyes.
"Brother Yang, what's the secret in this? Why can you...be favored by Miss Qingya!"
Li Kui paused slightly, but in the end he didn't say the words "go through the back door".
He also wanted to know how to get through the back door. How cool would it be to use the elegant girl's back door?
